question: How much concrete has been poured?
answer: Most of it recently. China used more cement in three years — roughly 2011 to 2013 — than the United States used across the entire twentieth century. The built world is not an inheritance from the distant past so much as something assembled within living memory.
move: China poured more cement in three years than America did in a hundred.
source: US Geological Survey; International Cement Review
